problem: Find the real part of the matrix $A=[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} & 7-6\text{i} \\ -\text{i} & 4\end{aligned}].$
worked_solution:
For the given matrix $A,$ we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}A & =[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} & 7-6\text{i} \\ -\text{i} & 4\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}1+2\text{i} & 7-6\text{i} \\ 0-\text{i} & 4+0\text{i}\end{aligned}] \\  & ={{[\begin{aligned}1 & 7 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Re}(A)}+\text{i}{{[\begin{aligned}2 & -6 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{\text{Im}(A)}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $\text{Re}(A)=[\begin{aligned}1 & 7 \\ 0 & 4\end{aligned}].$
